profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bergstrom Inc.
profile.summary: Electrical Engineering undergraduate at the University of Illinois with a minor in physics.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Helped with maintenance of the vacuum chamber, and vacuum pumps.
•	Connected all electrical equipment and soldered components for experiments.
•	Designed and ran experiments for plasma treatment of various foils.

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked in a test lab where I solved connection issues in electrical equipment.
•	Designed electrical harnesses and adapters for various lab equipment.
•	Created detailed schematics for undocumented parts.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•Designed test equipment for the secondary power distribution systems.
•Responsible for working with customers on design changes by releasing updates on technical   drawings.
•In charge of creating parts lists and ordering parts for E2 Embraer project.
•Ran various tests on equipment to insure it was up to standard and matched the design.

positions.title: Crew Trainer
positions.description:
•In charge of training all new crew members on every position in the store.
•I managed the grill area and directed crew to complete various jobs.
